gloss: principal (of a kindergarten or preschool); director

definitions.gloss: principal of a kindergarten or nursery; director
definitions.explanation: The head of a 幼稚園 (kindergarten) or 保育園 (nursery). Also used for the director of facilities ending in 園, such as a botanical garden or zoo.

examples.japanese: {園長|えんちょう}{先生|せんせい}にあいさつする。
{新|あたら}しい{園長|えんちょう}が{就任|しゅうにん}した。
{入園式|にゅうえんしき}で{園長|えんちょう}が{保護者|ほごしゃ}にあいさつをした。
examples.english: At the entrance ceremony, the principal greeted the parents.

notes:
Compound of {園|えん} (garden; facility ending in 園) + {長|ちょう} (head, chief). In everyday school contexts it means the head of a kindergarten or nursery, usually addressed as {園長|えんちょう}{先生|せんせい}.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {校長|こうちょう}: principal — of an elementary, junior-high, or high school
- {学長|がくちょう}: president — of a university
- {理事長|りじちょう}: chairman — head of a board of directors
